data.name: Capability.Fallback.Description
data.value: Authorizes the administrative operation identified by this capability. Review the module documentation before delegating it to an automation.

data.name: Capability.identity.clients.read.Description
data.value: Used on the Applications and client detail screens to read the Client ID, type, flows, URLs, permissions, and token policies. It does not allow changes to the registration.

data.name: Capability.identity.clients.create.Description
data.value: Used in the new application wizard to create a client and its Client ID. It does not grant permission to edit or delete existing clients.

data.name: Capability.identity.clients.update.Description
data.value: Used to change a client's URLs, flows, scopes, consent, PKCE, and token policies. Changes affect subsequent authentications for that application.

data.name: Capability.identity.clients.delete.Description
data.value: Used to remove a client registration from the provider. Reserve it for retiring an integration because it can prevent new application sign-ins.

data.name: Capability.identity.branding.read.Description
data.value: Used in Branding to view published themes, logos, colors, and other visual assets. It does not allow changes to the authentication experience.

data.name: Capability.identity.branding.manage.Description
data.value: Used to create, update, publish, or remove Branding settings. Changes can alter the appearance of authentication screens for users.

data.name: Capability.identity.users.read.Description
data.value: Used in the directory and user details to find accounts and view profiles, status, and access methods. It does not allow changes to data or credentials.

data.name: Capability.identity.users.create.Description
data.value: Used for the administrative registration of a new account in the provider. By itself, it does not allow claims to be assigned or other users to be changed.

data.name: Capability.identity.users.update.Description
data.value: Used to change profile data such as name, email, and phone number on user administration screens. It does not reset passwords, block, or delete accounts.

data.name: Capability.identity.users.disable.Description
data.value: Used in user details to prevent or restore account access. It is independent from profile editing and password resets.

data.name: Capability.identity.users.delete.Description
data.value: Used to remove an account from the provider through administration. It is a sensitive operation separate from permissions to block or edit the user.

data.name: Capability.identity.users.reset.Description
data.value: Used in user details to set a new administrative password and signal the credential change. It does not allow profile or other access methods to be edited.

data.name: Capability.identity.claims.read.Description
data.value: Used in Claims to list custom attributes assigned to accounts. It supports identity diagnostics but does not change values.

data.name: Capability.identity.claims.create.Description
data.value: Used to add a new custom attribute to an account. The claim may affect information and decisions consumed by integrated applications.

data.name: Capability.identity.claims.update.Description
data.value: Used to change the type or value of an assigned custom claim. The change may appear in tokens and sessions issued afterward.

data.name: Capability.identity.claims.delete.Description
data.value: Used to remove a custom attribute from an account. Apply it carefully when applications depend on that claim for authorization.

data.name: Capability.identity.scopes.read.Description
data.value: Used to list and inspect scopes, resources, associated claims, and display properties. It does not change what clients can request.

data.name: Capability.identity.scopes.create.Description
data.value: Used to register a new scope that applications can request in authorization flows. Assigning it to clients remains a separate configuration.

data.name: Capability.identity.scopes.update.Description
data.value: Used to change a scope's description, resources, claims, and other properties. The change can affect tokens later issued to authorized applications.

data.name: Capability.identity.scopes.delete.Description
data.value: Used to remove a scope from the provider. It can break requests from applications that still depend on it and should follow an inventory review.

data.name: Capability.identity.sessions.read.Description
data.value: Used in Sessions to find active sign-ins and inspect the client, user, dates, and state. It does not end any session.

data.name: Capability.identity.sessions.revoke.Description
data.value: Used to revoke a selected session and prevent it from continuing. It is appropriate for administrative sign-out, lost devices, or security incidents.

data.name: Capability.identity.authorizations.read.Description
data.value: Used to list persisted consent and grants between users and applications. It allows granted access to be investigated without revoking it.

data.name: Capability.identity.authorizations.revoke.Description
data.value: Used to withdraw a persisted grant or consent. The application must obtain a new authorization before it can use that access again.

data.name: Capability.identity.audit.read.Description
data.value: Used in Audit to investigate who performed an operation, which capability was used, the target, result, and correlation ID. It does not modify recorded events.

data.name: Capability.identity.database.read.Description
data.value: Used in the operational monitor to view connectivity, latency, queues, and connection pool state. It does not allow business records or SQL commands to be accessed.

data.name: Capability.identity.metrics.read.Description
data.value: Used in Metrics to view volume, failures, active applications, and collector status. It does not allow retention or export settings to be changed.

data.name: Capability.identity.metrics.manage.Description
data.value: Used to enable collection and define retention, batch size, timeout, and metric export. The change modifies the collector's operational behavior.

data.name: Capability.identity.vault.secrets.read.Description
data.value: Used in Vault to list names, contexts, and metadata for secrets available to the operator. The interface does not reveal the stored value.

data.name: Capability.identity.vault.secrets.manage.Description
data.value: Used in Vault to write, replace, or remove secret values in authorized namespaces. This is a sensitive capability, and every change is audited.

data.name: Capability.identity.provisioning.preview.Description
data.value: Used in Provisioning to run inventory and preview and show differences before applying them. It does not modify clients, scopes, or other resources.

data.name: Capability.identity.provisioning.apply.Description
data.value: Used in Enforce mode to create, update, or reconcile resources described by a manifest. The operation requires confirmation and produces auditable evidence.

data.name: Capability.identity.management.tokens.read.Description
data.value: Used in Tokens to open the workspace and list metadata for the authenticated administrator's temporary tokens. The Bearer value is never retrieved by the list.

data.name: Capability.identity.management.tokens.issue.Description
data.value: Used to generate a temporary Bearer with a subset of capabilities already held by the administrator. This capability cannot be delegated to the token itself.

data.name: Capability.identity.management.tokens.revoke.Description
data.value: Used to invalidate a temporary token before it expires. This capability cannot be included in another temporary token.
